name: Synology
description: Shows a Synology NAS (DiskStation Manager 7, 6.2 works too) as a host with its Container Manager containers, Virtual Machine Manager machines and installed packages as guests, each matched to the device Netlens found by MAC address (then IP). Reads through the DSM web API over HTTPS, read-only. Needs a dedicated user in the administrators group (DSM offers no read-only API role); see the settings page. Also fills the Storage page (Netlens 0.4.180).
author: Netlens
supports: Synology DSM 7.2 (confirmed on real Synology hardware by the maintainer; also tested on a virtual DSM 7.2.2 with Container Manager 24.0.2)

releases.changelog: iSCSI: LUNs of SAN Manager with size, space used and the hosts logged in.
Also fills the Storage page (pools, volumes, disks, shares). Needs Netlens 0.4.180 or newer.

Tested against a real DSM 7.2.2. The container list of DSM has no ports or networks, so the plugin now reads them per container (docker inspect): published ports (also for stopped containers) and the address of a container on a macvlan network. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Containers, virtual machines and packages of a Synology NAS as guests of the NAS. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
